label: Real models, simulated PayPal stand-in
arms: Same refund calls through Owed's gate
card: We gave 3 AI models PayPal's refund tool and changed only the shop's instructions. Each model ran each test case once, and every refund call it made was replayed unchanged through Owed's gate. Adversarial test cases (162 per setting, $5 owed) where the AI alone paid more than was owed: 49 with a typical shop prompt ($920.00), 3 with our strictest prompt ($60.00). The same calls through Owed's gate: 0, 0. Legitimate test cases (48 per setting) paid in full by the AI alone: 43 with a typical shop prompt, 47 with our strictest prompt. Through the gate alone: 43, 47. With Owed's recovery step as well: 46, 48.
